spans.s: AT0138 जङ्गमं स्यादधोभागम् jaṅgamaṁ syādadhobhāgam The tendency of animate poison is to move downwards and affect the lower body more.
AT0139 जङ्गमंस्याद् उर्ध्वभागं jaṅgamaṁsyād urdhvabhāgaṁ Gangadhar commentary on charak samhita says the tendency of animate poisons is to move upwards in the body. उध्िशबागॊ
AT0140 जङ्गमस्थावर् विष योनि jaṅgamasthāvar viṣa yoni Poison is of two types one is jangam (animal origin-mobile) & another is sthavar (plant and mineral origin- immobile).
SR0163 जङ्घास्थिनी jaṅghāsthinī Tibia & fibula. Bones of the leg
DG0096 जाङ्गम jāṅgama Substance of animal origin like honey, milk, flesh, blood, nail, etc.
AT0133 जाङ्गम विष jāṅgama viṣa The poison of animate origin in creatures like snakes, insects, spiders, scorpions, leeches, fish, frog, dogs, lion, tiger, jackal, hyena, etc.
